title: JSFL element.width/height broken on symbol instances
description:
File: packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, function makeElementProxy (line 286).

Bug 1 — GET: element.width and element.height on a SymbolInstance fall through to Reflect.get(current, 'width') (line 413). SymbolInstance has no 'width' field (its width is naturalWidth * scaleX), so this returns undefined. The correct implementation is: if obj.type === 'instance', return (inst.naturalWidth ?? 100) * (inst.scaleX ?? 1) for 'width' and similarly for 'height'.

Bug 2 — SET: element.width = 200 on a SymbolInstance goes through the default path (line 499-516) which calls updateDisplayObject({ width: 200 }). DisplayObjectUpdates (packages/core/src/model/timeline.ts lines 7-33) includes 'width' only for text objects; on a SymbolInstance the spread { ...inst, width: 200 } adds a 'width' field that the renderer never reads (the renderer computes naturalWidth * scaleX). The correct fix mirrors setProperty case 2 (lines 3856-3863): compute scaleX = value / (naturalWidth || 1) and call updateDisplayObject({ scaleX }) instead.

Contrast with setProperty (line 3827) which already handles this correctly for doc.selection.setProperty(2, v). The element proxy is inconsistent.

Fix: add special-case handling in the get trap for 'width' and 'height' (after the colorEffect check at line 408) and in the set trap (before the default path at line 499) that mirrors the setProperty logic.
